LESSON: PRECAUTIONS WHEN USING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and 1.7 Energy: Light By the end of the sub-strand, the  Learners t
Topic 1.7.3: Precautions when using

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Precautions when using. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: which light the eyes (reading in dim light, harm us?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Precautions when using means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Precautions when using from Kenya
3. practise Precautions when using in clear steps
4. apply Precautions when using in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: PRECAUTIONS WHEN USING
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Precautions when using helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: PRECAUTIONS WHEN USING
Study Precautions when using like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Precautions when using means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Precautions when using means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Precautions when using means in simple pupil language.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Precautions when using” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Precautions when using means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Precautions when using from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Precautions when using from Kenya. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Precautions when using from Kenya.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why Precautions when using matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Precautions when using from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Precautions when using in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Precautions when using in clear steps. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Precautions when using in clear steps.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Apply: Describe one safe action you can take related to Precautions when using this week.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Precautions when using in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Precautions when using in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Precautions when using in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Precautions when using in one real-life situation this week.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Precautions when using” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Precautions when using in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Precautions when using is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Precautions when using” around your school. (skill: explain what Precautions when using means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Say why Precautions when using matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Precautions when using from Kenya)

Example 3: Describe one safe action you can take related to Precautions when using this week. (skill: practise Precautions when using in clear steps)

Example 4: Name what you can see/touch about “Precautions when using” around your school. (skill: apply Precautions when using in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Precautions when using to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Precautions when using means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Precautions when using from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Precautions when using in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Precautions when using from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Precautions when using: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study Precautions when using?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. which light the eyes (reading in dim light, harm us?
2. when using light energy. precautions in protecting self and energy?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Precautions when using means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Precautions when using means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Precautions when using from Kenya.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
